_note: Authored attachment footprints: per-muscle vertex index lists, resolved from a handful of anatomical seeds by geodesic growth over the mesh. Only muscles listed here are reassigned; every other muscle keeps the solver's own nearest-bone assignment, deliberately -- five attempts to INFER footprints from geometry each measured worse than that baseline, because these muscles wrap the humerus and contact is not attachment. The two pectoral heads use LINE seeds along the sternal border, the costal cartilages and the clavicle, because those origins are lines and a single centroid seed under-specified them.
